Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados por um propósito compartilhado de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, contamos com um portfólio diversificado de marcas e soluções, em diferentes países da América Latina, que contemplam todas as fases da jornada do morar e ainda um Hub de Tecnologia em Portugal. Desenvolvemos tecnologias e inovação para transformar e impulsionar a experiência de moradia como um todo.

Com o apoio de uma equipe de classe mundial de investidores e consultores, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic e SoftBank, o Grupo QuintoAndar está atualmente avaliado em mais de US$ 5,1 bilhões e continua a crescer ano após ano.

Aqui você trabalhará com os melhores profissionais do mercado, em um ambiente que respira inovação, colaboração e alto desempenho. Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse https://grupoquintoandar.com/pt/ 

 

Localização & Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido

Nosso time trabalha com o modelo “híbrido”, sendo necessário estar presencialmente no escritório, localizado em São Paulo, 1 vez por semana.

 

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

As etapas dos nossos processos seletivos têm como objetivo avaliar suas experiências e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e oportunidades de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

  • Triagem;
  • Verificação de Laudo PcD;
  • Etapa People;
  • Etapa Gestão;
  • Case; 
  • Stakeholder.
  • Offer. 

 

Sobre a Área

No QuintoAndar, a área de Inside Sales não atua apenas como vendedores; mas consultores de confiança dos proprietários de imóveis. A missão do time é garantir supply para nossa plataforma e gerenciar carteira de imóveis utilizando inteligência de dados para identificar gargalos de conversão. O time atua ativamente orientando proprietários sobre precificação, qualidade do anúncio e estratégias de mercado, garantindo que o imóvel não fique "parado" e encontre o inquilino no menor tempo possível.

 

Requisitos

  • Liderança: Experiência sólida em gestão de times comerciais (Inside Sales), com histórico de formação de equipes e entrega de resultados consistentes;
  • DNA Analítico: Capacidade de navegar por números e métricas de funil para tomar decisões. Você não precisa ser um cientista de dados, mas precisa amar planilhas e indicadores de conversão;
  • Expertise em Vendas Consultivas: Vivência em operações de alta escala onde a venda é feita através de geração de valor e consultoria, não apenas transacional;
  • Gestão de Mudança: Habilidade para estruturar processos e se adaptar rapidamente em um ambiente de hiper crescimento.
  • Conhecimento em PNL (Programação Neurolinguística) aplicada a vendas (diferencial);
  • Experiência prévia em startups, proptechs ou empresas de tecnologia (diferencial);
  • Vivência com Salesforce ou CRMs similares (diferencial).

 

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e desenvolver um time de analistas de vendas com senioridade mista, atuando como referência técnica e comportamental;
  • Conduzir rituais de gestão consistentes (1:1s, reuniões de time, feedbacks estruturados e PDI), promovendo um clima de alta performance, responsabilidade (accountability) e engajamento;
  • Desenvolver talentos, focando em coaching comercial (análise de calls, mensagens e pitch), elevando a barra de negociação e argumentação do time.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de imóveis com foco total em liquidez: definir estratégias para aumentar o volume de negócios e reduzir o tempo de vacância dos anúncios;
  • Realizar diagnósticos profundos do funil de vendas (conversão por etapa, eficiência por canal, cohorts), traduzindo dados em planos de ação práticos para alavancar resultados;
  • Acompanhar e reportar KPIs operacionais e táticos, garantindo visibilidade da performance para os stakeholders;
  • Avaliar e evoluir constantemente os scripts e abordagens de vendas, aplicando técnicas de persuasão e PNL para contorno de objeções complexas.

 

Importante

  • O nosso processo seletivo começa na candidatura! Se você está realmente a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, foque nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno para todas as pessoas que investiram tempo em se candidatar
  • Toda comunicação é feita por e-mail, então fique atento às nossas mensagens e libere o domínio @quintoandar.com.br para nossos e-mails não irem parar no spam.

 

Benefícios

  • Salário competitivo
  • PLR - Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Remuneração variável (Somente para vagas comerciais)
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação 
  • Plano de saúde - Colaboradores PcDs não possuem coparticipação
  • Plano odontológico 
  • Seguro de vida
  • Auxílio creche e Auxílio parentalidade atípica
  • Wellhub 
  • Auxílio home office
  • QuintoCare: Nosso programa de apoio (saúde mental, assistência social, apoio jurídico e financeiro)
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Dia livre de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais
  • Clube de Benefícios (descontos em serviços do dia a dia)
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino
  • Kit leiturinha para crianças - Playkids

 

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público-alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.


Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento.

qedinvestors-swap:ashbyhq:11d0890f-25e6-.title: Legal Counsel
qedinvestors-swap:ashbyhq:11d0890f-25e6-.description:
About Swap

Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience.

Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence.

At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a mid-level Commercial & Product Counsel (3-6 PQE) to become the second member of our legal team. This is a unique opportunity to influence the foundations of a global legal function within a fast-scaling, post-Series C technology company. You will work closely with our Senior Legal Counsel and partner cross-functionally on commercial contracting, product development, privacy, and regulatory matters across the US, UK, and EU. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in fast-paced environments, and is motivated to build structure where none exists.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead commercial and partner contracting across customer, vendor, and procurement work streams, including SMB, mid-market, and enterprise negotiations. 

 - Maintain, develop, and improve contract templates, playbooks, negotiation guidelines, and scalable legal processes. 

 - Support product development initiatives, including our agentic shopfront and broader platform capabilities, by delivering pragmatic legal guidance. 

 - Contribute to global privacy maturity efforts (e.g., UK GDPR/US privacy), including DPAs, SCCs, data mapping, and privacy-by-design reviews. 

 - Advise cross-functional teams (Sales, Success, Ops, Product, Engineering, Security) as a hands-on legal partner. 

 - Support regulatory work streams related to tax and cross-border shipping products. 

 - Provide region-specific support depending on location (US: commercial and state-law nuances; UK: customer/vendor negotiations and UK privacy requirements). 

 - Assist with generalist legal work, including corporate governance, employment queries, marketing reviews, and light legal-ops improvements. 


WHAT WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE:

 - 3-6 years working experience as lawyer or internal counsel, with experience in commercial contracting, product counselling, privacy/GDPR, and/or US/UK tech contracting. 

 - Ability to operate autonomously and make pragmatic, business-first decisions in ambiguous and evolving environments. 

 - Strong communication skills, capable of translating legal concepts into practical, actionable advice for non-legal stakeholders. 

 - Experience supporting product development or cross-functional teams in a high-growth tech, ecommerce, logistics, or SaaS setting is a plus. 

 - Comfort establishing new processes and improving existing workflows. 

 - A collaborative, humble working style and willingness to partner with teams across the organisation. 

 - Ability to work independently with globally distributed colleagues. 



Benefits:

 - Competitive base salary 💰

 - Stock options in a high-growth startup 🚀

 - Competitive PTO with public holidays additional (and your birthday off!) 🌴

 - Pension contributions 🛡️

 - Private health 🏥

 - Gym and wellness benefits 💪

 - Mental health benefits 🧠

 - Quarterly team offsite budget 🎉

 - Thursday happy hour 🍻

 - Breakfast Mondays 🥐

Diversity & Equal Opportunities:

We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's also the smart thing.

qplusequality-applovin:greenhouse:468598.title: Partner Solutions Engineer, Ads
qplusequality-applovin:greenhouse:468598.description:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising and AI solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

Fortune recognizes AppLovin as one of the Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and the company has been a Certified Great Place to Work for the last four years (2021-2024). Check out the rest of our awards HERE.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly-motivated Partner Solutions Engineer - Ads in Palo Alto. This is not a traditional support role. You will operate as a forward-deployed engineer at the intersection of product, engineering, and our partner ecosystem, owning the technical relationship with our most strategic 3P integration partners.

We are actively building next-generation integration flows with partners. This role exists to make those integrations succeed, accelerate adoption of our CAPI and tracking infrastructure, and ensure that integration friction gets fed back into the product rather than buried in a ticket queue. 90% of this role is partner-facing: guiding advertisers and integration partners through correct implementation, troubleshooting issues quickly, providing strategic guidance, and proactively identifying gaps in our APIs and flows. The remaining 10% is hands-on: when you see a recurring friction point, you build the fix.

We want someone who treats every recurring partner issue as a signal that something in our product, API, or documentation can be improved, and who has the technical depth to act on it. You will work directly with AppLovin's engineering teams and leadership, with real influence over how our integration ecosystem evolves. The partners you support will be some of the most strategically important to Axon's growth.

A Day in the Life

Partner Integration & Enablement

  • Own the end-to-end technical onboarding and integration experience for strategic 3P partners across CAPI, web SDK, and APIs
  • Guide advertisers and partners through correct implementation of Axon's tracking and data infrastructure, proactively identifying and resolving misconfigurations before they impact performance
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for partner-specific issues across new integration pilots, including API flows and sandbox/testing environments
  • Drive adoption by translating complex technical requirements into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences

Analytical Problem Solving

  • Investigate, reproduce, and resolve technical issues with web SDK, CAPI, and API integrations, pinpointing root causes through data analysis
  • Query and visualize large data sets to identify anomalies, performance drops, attribution discrepancies, and integration edge cases
  • Build internal tooling and scripts to streamline troubleshooting, automate validation steps, and accelerate partner debugging
  • Spot patterns across partner issues and translate recurring friction points into concrete product improvement recommendations

Cross-Functional Impact

  • Work closely with AppLovin's engineering teams to architect and prioritize solutions to integration problems at scale
  • Act as the connective tissue between partners and our internal engineering teams, ensuring partner feedback directly influences product and API roadmap decisions
  • Support new integration pilots across partners, owning sandbox validation and proactive issue resolution so core engineering stays focused on building
  • Influence decision-making through data-centric presentations to internal stakeholders and leadership

Who You Are 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with production-quality code in dynamic environments
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong foundation in web-based integrations: experience with CAPI, server-side tracking, APIs, pixels, or equivalent ad tech infrastructure
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or general-purpose language (Python, JavaScript, or similar) with the ability to build lightweight tooling independently
  • Experience querying large data sets with SQL; comfort working directly in data to debug, validate, and surface insights
  • Clear, precise written communicator, equally at ease in internal technical discussions and external partner communications

Preferred Qualifications

jobDescription.title: Partner Solutions Engineer, Ads
jobDescription.description:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising and AI solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

Fortune recognizes AppLovin as one of the Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and the company has been a Certified Great Place to Work for the last four years (2021-2024). Check out the rest of our awards HERE.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly-motivated Partner Solutions Engineer - Ads in Palo Alto. This is not a traditional support role. You will operate as a forward-deployed engineer at the intersection of product, engineering, and our partner ecosystem, owning the technical relationship with our most strategic 3P integration partners.

We are actively building next-generation integration flows with partners. This role exists to make those integrations succeed, accelerate adoption of our CAPI and tracking infrastructure, and ensure that integration friction gets fed back into the product rather than buried in a ticket queue. 90% of this role is partner-facing: guiding advertisers and integration partners through correct implementation, troubleshooting issues quickly, providing strategic guidance, and proactively identifying gaps in our APIs and flows. The remaining 10% is hands-on: when you see a recurring friction point, you build the fix.

We want someone who treats every recurring partner issue as a signal that something in our product, API, or documentation can be improved, and who has the technical depth to act on it. You will work directly with AppLovin's engineering teams and leadership, with real influence over how our integration ecosystem evolves. The partners you support will be some of the most strategically important to Axon's growth.

A Day in the Life

Partner Integration & Enablement

  • Own the end-to-end technical onboarding and integration experience for strategic 3P partners across CAPI, web SDK, and APIs
  • Guide advertisers and partners through correct implementation of Axon's tracking and data infrastructure, proactively identifying and resolving misconfigurations before they impact performance
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for partner-specific issues across new integration pilots, including API flows and sandbox/testing environments
  • Drive adoption by translating complex technical requirements into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences

Analytical Problem Solving

  • Investigate, reproduce, and resolve technical issues with web SDK, CAPI, and API integrations, pinpointing root causes through data analysis
  • Query and visualize large data sets to identify anomalies, performance drops, attribution discrepancies, and integration edge cases
  • Build internal tooling and scripts to streamline troubleshooting, automate validation steps, and accelerate partner debugging
  • Spot patterns across partner issues and translate recurring friction points into concrete product improvement recommendations

Cross-Functional Impact

  • Work closely with AppLovin's engineering teams to architect and prioritize solutions to integration problems at scale
  • Act as the connective tissue between partners and our internal engineering teams, ensuring partner feedback directly influences product and API roadmap decisions
  • Support new integration pilots across partners, owning sandbox validation and proactive issue resolution so core engineering stays focused on building
  • Influence decision-making through data-centric presentations to internal stakeholders and leadership

Who You Are 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with production-quality code in dynamic environments
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong foundation in web-based integrations: experience with CAPI, server-side tracking, APIs, pixels, or equivalent ad tech infrastructure
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or general-purpose language (Python, JavaScript, or similar) with the ability to build lightweight tooling independently
  • Experience querying large data sets with SQL; comfort working directly in data to debug, validate, and surface insights
  • Clear, precise written communicator, equally at ease in internal technical discussions and external partner communications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in ad tech, performance marketing, or e-commerce advertising, with familiarity with attribution, data signals, ROAS, and measurement concepts
  • Hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Google Tag Manager, or equivalent
  • Experience working with enterprise or strategic B2B partners in a technical capacity
  • Track record of identifying product gaps from operational experience and driving improvements back into engineering roadmaps
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the answer isn't always written down
  • Prior experience in a solutions engineering, partner engineering, or forward-deployed engineering role

qplusequality-coupa-software:lever:3c624.title: Customer Value Manager - 11276
qplusequality-coupa-software:lever:3c624.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. 

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. 


The Impact of a Customer Value Manager at Coupa:
 
We are seeking a Customer Value Manager to lead a portfolio of customers across different industries and customer segments. In this role, you will be the primary customer-facing advocate, responsible for developing and driving mutual success plans, engagement strategies, and frameworks for measurable impact. You will use a strong executive presence and a deep understanding of Source-to-Pay (or what we call, Business Spend Management) to advise customers on how to transform the way they manage BSM, creating immediate value and efficiency.
 
Customer Value Managers represent the primary point of contact between Coupa and our customers.  As a trusted partner, you will drive customer value by building strong relationships with a variety of stakeholders and customer leaders. You will also work with, coach, and advise customer teams to drive success strategies and mutual goals.  In addition, you will collaborate directly with pre-sales, post-sales, product, and other internal teams, while also gaining exposure to different customer industries.

qumracapital-appsflyer:greenhouse:839383.title: Senior Event Marketing Manager (Beijing)
qumracapital-appsflyer:greenhouse:839383.description:
Senior Event Marketing Manager, GCR

Location: Beijing, China

Travel: 30%

What is #LifeAtAF?

It’s the spark that powers everything we do.

At AppsFlyer, culture isn’t a perk - it’s our people. Every team member brings a mix of grit, curiosity, and heart. We challenge each other to grow, support one another as mentors, and show up every day with purpose and pride.

Are you a passionate B2B marketing professional who wants to grow your career by working on numerous projects for a market-leading mobile SaaS company? You’ll be joining a team of seven amazing individuals responsible for growing revenue, customer satisfaction, and brand awareness across GCR. You’ll be involved in all aspects of our marketing mix and developing skills to help you take your career to the next level.

In GCR, we're looking for a savvy yet humble Marketing Manager with B2B experience, a passionate and seasoned event marketing manager to initiate and produce unforgettable events in the Greater China Region. They should have an ALL-IN spirit, learn fast, and not be afraid to take risks by going above and beyond to drive our marketing programs to the next level. They thrive in a dynamic environment, are creative, data-driven, and an independent self-starter -- while knowing how to orchestrate initiatives between regional and global marketing teams and their goals.

What you will do

  • Execute marketing plans that meet overall business goals for the Greater China Region on an offline activity and brand marketing level.
  • Take a leading role in the planning and production of unique hosted events in Greater China from beginning to end (like significant brand flagship summit - MAMA, and top industry summit - ChinaJoy, etc.), including ideation, logistics, budget, partner coordination, vendor selection, branding, documentation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration skills with the ability to manage stakeholders from across the company: Sales, Customer Success, Product, and the Global Marketing Teams.
  • Work closely with other marketing function managers within AppsFlyer, including PR/Social, Paid Media, Branding, Content, etc., to ensure high-efficiency cross-functional collaboration.
  • Manage agencies and POCs throughout GCR, ensuring positioning and messages are conveyed effectively and consistently across various target stakeholders and channels, while constantly measuring results and optimizing for success.
  • Constantly evaluate, prioritize, and optimize opportunities as they arise.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the products, competition, industry, marketing goals, and objectives.

Minimum Requirements

  • Native Chinese speaker,
  • Advanced proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Bachelor’s degree with a track record of academic excellence.
  • 5+ years of event marketing experience, with tracked experience managing significant brand-owned summits (premium VIP activities ideally), in the B2B or high-tech field; international company experience is a strong plus.
  • Self-starter, high proactivity; able to work independently and leading initiatives in a rapidly growing company with a startup mindset; strong multi-tasking skills.
  • Empathetic, collaborative mindset; able to build trust and work efficiently with key stakeholders and other co-workers.
  • Highly detail-oriented with exceptional organizational, time management, and negotiation skills.
  • Works well under pressure.
  • High standards for production and deliverable quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the mobile, digital marketing, and/or advertising space.
  • Working experience in global agencies and in-house event marketing is a strong plus.

qumracapital-jfrog:greenhouse:7968129.title: Professional Services DevOps Architect
qumracapital-jfrog:greenhouse:7968129.description:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

If you love working with brilliant people, being part of an energetic team, changing the world of software and you’ve got the technical skills, you might be the perfect Frog to join our Swamp! Come and help us to continue to lead the rapidly evolving space of DevSecOps!

As a Professional Services DevOps Architect in JFrog you will...

  • Guide the DevOps, DevSecOps and MLOps journeys of JFrog’s most strategic customers, positing yourself as their trusted advisor
  • Work with JFrog customers to consult, architect, design and implement CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps platform using JFrog products and other cutting edge technologies and practices like Docker, Kubernetes, IaC and Cloud Native
  • Team up with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support and Development while work directly with Devs and DevSecOps Pros to ensure success with the customer’s DevSecOps journey using the JFrog platform
  • Mentor and coach members of the consulting team
  • Train the open source community and JFrog customers
  • Influence the features and roadmap of JFrog tools based on customer needs
  • Keep current with the latest technology trends related to DevSecOps and the landscape of CI/CD Technology
  • Work closely with our customers and community to build solid relationships

To be a Professional Services DevOps Architect in JFrog you need...

  • 15+ years of professional experience and 5+ years of experience working in professional services or consulting with enterprise customers
  • Experience with Continuous Integration tools: CI Server, Git, Artifactory, Jenkins, Maven, Docker, NPM
  • Ability to lead, architect and build software delivery pipelines with Docker, npm, Java, Pypi etc.. using various DevSecOps tools such as Git, Binary repositories management, Binary scanning, and Continuous integration
  • Good understanding of infrastructure & operations - storage, network, computer, security, cloud (public, on-prem)
  • Experience with Continuous Deployment and Delivery tools: Terraform, , Ansible, ArgoCD, Kubernetes
  • Hands on experience in Linux - Mandatory
  • Hands on experience with cloud infrastructure - AWS / Azure / GCP - Mandatory
  • Experience with customer facing with great interpersonal and customer service oriented skills
  • Experience with server side software on-premise and in the cloud
  • Experience with Software Architecture design and product development a plus
  • Experience with MLOps toolset & ecosystem is a plus
  • Uncompromising will to learn
  • Open Source state-of-mind

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

  • At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.
  • This position has a base salary range between $200,000 to $225,000.  Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.
  • Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.
  • This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
  • JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!
  • JFrog embraces hybrid work: 3 days in office / 2 days remote.

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

radical-cohere-2-735e1f36-781c-460d-afb7.title: Director, Total Rewards
radical-cohere-2-735e1f36-781c-460d-afb7.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.



We are a global technology company co-headquartered in Toronto and San Francisco, with key offices in London, New York City, Montreal, Seoul, Germany and Paris. Join us!

Role Overview

The Director, Total Rewards will have the unique opportunity to build and scale the global total rewards program at Cohere. This role is critical to establishing a global compensation and benefits framework that aligns with our company’s values, growth objectives, and competitive positioning in the tech industry. You’ll lead the design, implementation, and optimization of total rewards programs that support a diverse, distributed workforce.



Key Responsibilities

 - Build the Function: Enhance, design and launch global total rewards programs (vision, strategy, and roadmap) and align them with Cohere’s global growth goals.

 - Global Compensation Strategy: Implement a competitive, equitable, and scalable compensation structure for all roles across regions, including pay and equity.

 - Benefits & Perks: Design and manage a comprehensive, globally consistent benefits package that meets the diverse needs of Cohere’s employees, including health, wellness, retirement, and unique perks.

 - Market Research & Benchmarking: Conduct regular market analysis to ensure Cohere’s total rewards offerings remain competitive and aligned with industry standards.

 - Compliance & Governance: Ensure all total rewards programs comply with local labour laws, regulations, and tax requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with People, Finance, and leadership teams across the organization to align total rewards strategies with business objectives and budget constraints.

 - Communication & Education: Develop and deliver clear, engaging communications to employees about total rewards programs, ensuring transparency and understanding.

 - Data-Driven Decision Making: Use analytics to measure the effectiveness of total rewards initiatives and identify opportunities for improvement.

Qualifications

 - Experience: 10+ years in a total rewards role, with a proven track record of building and scaling total rewards functions at fast growing tech companies.

 - Global Expertise: Experience designing and managing total rewards programs for a global, distributed workforce across multiple regions.

 - Technical Skills: Strong analytical skills, proficiency in HRIS systems, and familiarity with industry leading compensation benchmarking tools.

 - Knowledge: Deep understanding of compensation philosophies, benefits regulations, and best practices in the tech industry.

 - Mindset: Strategic thinker with a passion for creating equitable, motivating, and scalable rewards programs. Alignment with Cohere’s values of innovation, collaboration, and integrity.



Note: This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations - there is no minimum in-office requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of location, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Cohere is committed to fair and transparent pay practices. The salary range listed for this role reflects the expected base compensation. Actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience. $190,000 - $300,000 USD




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly. We have offices in Toronto, San Francisco, New York City, London, Paris, Montreal, and more coming soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

As we continue to deliver fresh, seasonal ingredients and delicious, wholesome recipes to our customers, we are looking for new Sales Representatives to join our energetic sales team here in Perth!

If you are a foodie looking to leave behind your typical retail, financial, automotive or operations role, come and join a global food champion as our newest HelloFresh Sales Representative.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

  • Work road trips
  • Employee recognition & Rewards
  • Referral program
  • Incentives & Bonuses

remotely-hellofresh:greenhouse:7618818.title: Staff Data Scientist, Growth Alliance (f/m/x)
remotely-hellofresh:greenhouse:7618818.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

The Conversions Tech area enables meal brands to achieve ambitious growth targets through a seamless and high-performing conversion funnel. As a component of the Growth Alliance, this project drives growth for the HelloFresh group by powering marketing with advanced MarTech capabilities and product innovation. The focus is directed toward (re)acquisition, conversion optimization, and data-driven growth strategies.

In the capacity of a Staff Data Scientist within Conversions, the service provider contributes to shaping the intelligence that drives customized user journeys across conversion funnels. This involves directing complex feature engineering and optimization efforts, designing the data foundations and analytical approaches that power the decisioning platform for personalized experiences.

These services enable an automated engine to determine the optimal journey for a specific user at the appropriate time, based on intent, channel, and campaign context. Execution occurs at a strategic level, influencing how personalization is designed, evaluated, and scaled across various workstreams. This project carries direct accountability for advancing the data strategy and improving the user experience for the HelloFresh group across global markets.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

Decisioning, Modeling & Strategy

  • Direct and evolve the data and modeling strategy behind customized journeys and funnel decisioning.

  • Direct complex feature engineering initiatives that improve decision quality, robustness, and scalability.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate machine learning approaches for large-scale personalization and routing decisions.

  • Define standards for model validation, monitoring, and experimentation to ensure long-term reliability and impact.

Technical Coordination & Strategy

  • Act as a strategic technical resource for Product, Engineering, and Marketing, shaping how decisioning capabilities are embedded into the conversion funnels and experiences.

  • Drive alignment across technical workstreams on how personalization is measured, iterated, and scaled.

  • Provide technical frameworks for roadmap and prioritization decisions by framing problems in terms of data, impact, and trade-offs.

  • Contribute technical assessments to "build vs. buy" decisions related to data science tooling, platforms, and external solutions.

Platform & Enablement

  • Define and evolve shared decisioning frameworks and data products used across Conversions and adjacent domains.

  • Ensure analytical solutions are production-ready, observable, and efficient to iterate on.

  • Provide high-level technical guidance to other data scientists, setting a high bar for analytical rigor and project impact.

AI & Automation

  • Coordinate with engineering teams to bring these capabilities safely into production environments.

  • Explore how AI and automation can improve decisioning quality, experimentation velocity, and iteration speed.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

  • A minimum of 10 years of professional experience with a Master's degree, or a minimum of 5 years of professional experience with a Ph.D. degree, in a quantitative field.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data science, with a strong emphasis on personalization and marketing communications.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning principles and techniques relevant to send personalization and content creation including regression, classification, recommendation systems, clustering, natural language processing, and multi-armed / contextual bandit algorithms.
  • Proven ability to solve complex optimization problems that involve a large number of dimensions and optimization targets.
  • Proven ability to design and interpret A/B tests and quasi-experiments with synthetic controls to validate hypotheses related to the personalized communication strategy stream.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration capabilities.
  • Experience with customer behavior analysis, segmentation, and identifying high-value actions to drive customer lifetime value.
  • Experience in leveraging Generative AI (GenAI) models (e.g., LLMs) for content generation, including prompt engineering, model evaluation, and fine-tuning to create engaging and personalized customer communications.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

  • Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.
  • Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.
  • Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.
  • End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.
  • Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you.  We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

 

#Data

What we offer: The Toppings

  • Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.
  • Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.
  • Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.
  • End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.
  • Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you.  We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

remotely-hellofresh:greenhouse:7811846.title: Associate Category Manager, Strategy Sourcing
remotely-hellofresh:greenhouse:7811846.description:
S'more about the team

We are looking for an Associate Category Manager, Strategic Sourcing who will help us build out our vendor network and continuously improve our end-to-end sourcing process. Reporting to the Associate Director, Strategic Sourcing Fresh & Frozen, you will contribute to and execute our strategic roadmap, manage vendor relationships, support negotiations, launch new ingredients, and streamline internal procurement processes. As part of the Procurement team, you will play a key role in improving our costs, ingredient quality, supply chain reliability, and product innovation - helping us deliver the best possible value to our customers.

Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for:

  • Support development and execution of our sourcing strategy for the category, driving improvements and supply chain performance in:
    • Cost: consistently optimize our cost base
    • Quality: identify and reduce quality errors
    • Reliability: ensure supply availability and proactively mitigate risk in the supply chain
    • Customer offering: drive product innovation and create a unique competitive advantage
  • Leverage large internal datasets and industry benchmarks to report on team progress against objectives, identify and prioritize new opportunities, and drive continuous improvement
  • Support vendor negotiations and selection process, and lead any vendor onboarding/ offboarding as required
  • Lead projects that drive innovative and sustainable packaging solutions
  • Manage new and existing vendor relationships, manage pricing and supplier agreements, providing feedback on performance and collaborating on key initiatives
  • Work cross-functionally within the organization to prioritize and develop new products that deliver improved value for our customers
  • All other duties, as assigned

Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for: 

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, supply chain, or related discipline
  • 3-5 years of related experience in a hands-on, high-performance environment (ideal backgrounds include sourcing, supply chain, operations, or consulting)
  • Analytical and data skills: able to dig through data independently and draw helpful insights/conclusions. Strong Excel skills are a must!
  • Structured approach and communication style: ability to clearly and persuasively communicate with a large variety of stakeholders
  • A love for solving complex, ambiguous problems in a fast-paced environment with constant change and limited direction
  • Bonus: Strategic sourcing or buying experience, ideally across different steps of the sourcing process; comfortable managing negotiations with vendors

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here

  • Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
  • Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!
  • RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered
  • Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance. 
  • Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.
  • Growth & Development - We support your career progression, provide development opportunities, and invest in your continued learning through our organization wide L&D fund.
  • Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!
  • Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.
  • Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience. 

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#LI-HYBRID

Working Conditions

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process. 

 

HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.

This is a posting for an existing vacancy. We are actively seeking to fill this position.

 

Interested in joining the HelloFresh team? Don’t be chai, apply! Submit your application in PDF format today.

Toronto, ON Pay Range
$70,000—$80,000 CAD

remotely-hellofresh:greenhouse:7967815.description:
Content Creation Manager

The Content Creation Manager is a critical, hands-on role responsible for the successful creation of all new training materials for onsite and online distribution across multiple disciplines.  You will serve as the primary owner, coordinating with various teams and pyramids while evaluating risks to ensure seamless operational readiness and minimal business disruption. This position requires a strong blend of technical acumen, time management discipline, and stakeholder communication expertise.

You will.......

  • Serves as the primary point of contact from the Global Value Stream organization for development of all training programs for Distribution Centers and centralized offices, and as needed for other ancillary partners.

  • Ensure proper roll out and training plan execution with the local team responsible for content distribution.

  • Develop comprehensive plans, including scope definition, detailed work breakdown structures, schedules, and resource allocation.

  • Coordinate and drive alignment across internal teams (Operations, OpEX, Training, HR, Safety et al) to meet expected timelines.

  • Identify, track, and mitigate project risks and dependencies, escalating critical issues to leadership with proposed solutions.

  • Document and standardize content request processes, creating post-mortem reports and implementing lessons learned to continuously improve future project execution.

You have......

  • Proven experience (5+ years) in content creation, preferably with digital/AI experience, within e-commerce, culinary or manufacturing environments.

  • Demonstrated success in managing multi-discipline projects simultaneously and across multiple facilities, in a fast paced, time sensitive environment.

  • Exceptional organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Ability to travel frequently (up to 50-75%) to sites, including internationally during critical project phases.

  • Familiarity with material handling equipment (MHE), culinary standards, and/or warehouse protocols is highly desirable.

You will get.....

  • Competitive salary & 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation
  • Paid parental leave (16 weeks)
  • Generous PTO policy
  • Day one benefit coverage for health/dental/vision ($0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans)
  • 75% discount on your subscription to HelloFresh, as well as other product initiatives
  • Snacks, coffee & catered meals   
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

It is the policy of HelloFresh not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or because he or she is a protected veteran. 

Newark, NJ Pay Range
$101,430—$117,300 USD

remotely-mapbox:ashbyhq:088c744c-bc52-42.title: Security Engineer II
remotely-mapbox:ashbyhq:088c744c-bc52-42.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 




WHAT WE DO

Mapbox is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to join our Security & Compliance team. As a member of our diverse and globally distributed team, you’ll help all Mapbox engineers build secure-by-default systems. Engineers on the Security & Compliance team build scanning and threat detection systems to monitor Mapbox’s cloud deployment (AWS-native, mainly container-based, 7 global regions including China) and other digital assets. They conduct risk assessments of new vendor integrations and product launches, and facilitate a bug bounty program that leverages the diverse expertise of a global community of security researchers. Lastly, they build and maintain core standards around security, quality, and privacy—reflected in our compliance certifications—and the automation to monitor and enforce these standards across Mapbox.




WHAT WE DO

We’re excited to share our passion for scalable, engineering-driven, security with you, and for your perspective to help shape our team’s goals. You will be responsible for contributing to, operating, and improving all things related to our security and compliance services. In this role, you can expect to:

 - Conduct AWS security reviews (deep dive into our AWS environment to validate security best practices are being followed).

 - Make security improvements recommendations and work with our production support teams to implement security improvement in AWS.

 - Partner with the Lead Security Architect in fixing custom-built security tools bots.

 - Conduct in-depth security reviews of application code, working closely with developers to code securely from the outset and address issues early during coding and testing phases.

 - Partner with internal product teams to implement a secure-by-default design into their own products.




WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 - Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science or similar

 - 5+ years of experience in product or application security and related software engineering roles

 - Experience with AWS services like GuardDuty, CloudTrail log review, IAM, Security Groups, CloudFront, CloudFormation, S3, ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB and RDS.

 - Proficiency in a programming language (e.g. Python, JavaScript or Node.js or TypeScript), testing practices, and documentation.

 - Subject matter expertise in security best practices and the ability to quickly make correct risk assessments that prioritize the overall benefit to the company.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Additional experience with AWS services like API Gateway, CodeBuild, VPCs, Inspector, Advanced Shield, Athena, and Glue.

 - Strong proficiency in a programming language (e.g. JavaScript or Node.js or Python), testing practices, and thorough documentation.

 - Experience with SOC 2, GDPR, and ISO 9001 or ISO 27001 compliance standards a plus




WHAT WE VALUE

In addition to our core values https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

 - We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

 - We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

 - We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

 - We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.



By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice https://www.mapbox.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice/ for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

Read about Mapbox Navigation on our blog: https://blog.mapbox.com/tagged/navigation

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

 - Solve complex guidance scenarios that don’t have good solutions today

 - Develop best-in-class guidance experiences that make guidance enjoyable, not robotic

 - Provide highly customizable guidance solutions for large OEMs as well as very niche customers with unique use cases

 - Build the tools others will use to unlock incredible mapping and navigation solutions never seen before.

 - 5+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services

 - Experience engineering modern C++ or Rust and Linux server applications in a commercial or open-source development environment

 - Builds and maintains AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM) using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Knowledge of operating systems and distributed systems (e.g., fault-tolerance, consistency, service discovery, etc.)

 - A rigorous approach to problem solving, using experiments and data analysis to drive quality of service improvements

 - Willingness to go beyond your comfort zone and develop new skills across the full range of our stack

 


WHAT WE VALUE

remotely-w2o-group:greenhouse:5181936008.title: Manager (Medical Communications & Marketing)
remotely-w2o-group:greenhouse:5181936008.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

 

Account Manager – Deutschland

Real Chemistry sucht einen Account Manager für unser wachsendes Team in Deutschland!

 

Als Account Manager sind Sie der zentrale Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Tagesgeschäft, pflegen die Kundenbeziehungen und verantworten die Abwicklung mehrerer mittelgroßer Projekte. Sie steuern die Durchführung parallel laufender Projekte und tragen aktiv zu deren erfolgreichem Abschluss bei.

 

Agenturumfeld:

  • Sie haben die Möglichkeit, an internen Initiativen teilzunehmen, die zur Unternehmenskultur und Weiterentwicklung des Real Chemistry Germany-Teams beitragen (z. B. Compliance, Soziales, Inspiration)
  • Sie tauchen tief in die Pharma-/Biotech-Branche, Ihre Kundenunternehmen und Therapiegebiete ein und nutzen jede Gelegenheit, sich über Entwicklungen, Innovationen und Trends zu informieren. Sie suchen aktiv nach Möglichkeiten, diese in Ihre Arbeit einfließen zu lassen und Ihre Ideen mit Ihren Teams und dem gesamten Team zu teilen, um Ihr internes Profil zu stärken

 

Ihr Arbeitsalltag:

 

Kundenbetreuung:

  • Sie sind der tägliche Ansprechpartner für Ihre Kunden, informieren sie regelmäßig über den Projektstatus, beantworten ihre Anfragen und geben Empfehlungen. Sie managen die Kundenerwartungen hinsichtlich Zeitplan, Projektumfang etc. Sie nehmen Kundenbriefings entgegen und kommunizieren klar an Teammitglieder, um realistische Projektpläne umsetzen
  • Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft des eigenen Accounts, einschließlich der Verwaltung der Account-Prozesse (z. B. regelmäßige interne Teammeetings), des Arbeitsablaufs (z. B. Überprüfung von Inhalten anderer Teammitglieder), der Aufgabenverteilung (z. B. Überwachung von Statusberichten, um die Erledigung aller Teamaufgaben sicherzustellen) und des Status aller Aufträge im Account
  • Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für mittelgroße Kundenprojekte und stellen sicher, dass diese innerhalb des Budgets und des vereinbarten Zeitrahmens in höchster Qualität zum Abschluss kommen
  • Sie zeigen in der Kommunikation und bei der Arbeitsabwicklung aktiv Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Kunden (Strategie und Marke verstehen) und berücksichtigen deren Präferenzen
  • Sie erstellen souverän schriftliche Inhalte (z. B. Briefing-Dokumente) und haben Erfahrung in der Überprüfung der Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, um die Genauigkeit und hohe Qualität der Inhalte sicherzustellen

Geschäftsentwicklung:

  • Sie identifizieren Wachstumspotenziale (Weiterentwicklung bestehender Programme und/oder zusätzlicher Maßnahmen) und teilen neue Ideen proaktiv mit Team und Kunden
  • Sie wirken aktiv an der Neukundenakquise mit. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören die Durchführung und Präsentation von Recherchen für ein Pitch-Team, sowie die Moderation von Team-Input durch Brainstorming/Präsentation als Teil eines Pitch-Teams

Finanzmanagement:

  • Sie verwalten aktiv das Budget Ihrer Projekte und informieren Ihren Account Lead im Rahmen der Gesamtprogrammfinanzen. Sie erkennen, wenn ein Projekt den Rahmen sprengt, und benachrichtigen Ihren Vorgesetzten über den erforderlichen zusätzlichen Budgetbedarf
  • Sie erstellen präzise Budgets für Kunden, indem Sie frühere Projekte berücksichtigen und Kostenangebote einholen
  • Sie entwickeln ein umfassenderes Verständnis der Account-Finanzen über Ihre Projekte hinaus und unterstützen Ihren Account Lead proaktiv im Finanzmanagement, einschließlich der Verwaltung von Salesforce-Opportunities, Rechnungsstellung und Prognosen
  • Sie bringen sich in den Ressourcenplanungsprozess ein, indem Sie Anforderungen mit dem Ressourcenmanagement teilen
  • Sie füllen Ihre Stundenzettel und Spesenabrechnungen korrekt und fristgerecht aus und beteiligen sich aktiv an der Überprüfung der Stundenzettel in einigen Ihrer Projekte

 

Diese Position ist ideal für Sie, wenn:

  • Sie anpassungsfähig und belastbar sind und bereit sind, Ihren Aufgabenbereich, Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten und Ihren Fokus im Zuge unseres Wachstums anzupassen. Wenn sich die Dinge ändern, entwickeln wir uns mit. Wir entwickeln uns ständig weiter
  • Sie proaktiv, zielstrebig und einfallsreich sind, und über ausgeprägte Priorisierungsfähigkeiten verfügen; Sie den Wunsch haben, sich intensiv mit Daten auseinanderzusetzen
  • Sie sich durch Eigenstaendigkeit und Organisation auszeichnen, unter Zeitdruck arbeiten und mehrere Aufgaben parallel bewältigen koennen
  • Sie äußerst detailgenau arbeiten
  • Sie selbstständig denken und gerne Verantwortung für die Entwicklung von Projekten und Materialien übernehmen, aber gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer, der gerne zusammenarbeitet sind
  • Sie bei Bedarf souverän mit Vorgesetzten kommunizieren und diese informieren, wenn Fristen nicht eingehalten werden können oder Probleme absehbar sind
  • Sie sich durch eine hohe Arbeitsmoral auszeichnen und bereits erfolgreich Kundenanfragen bearbeitet und qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse termingerecht und im Budgetrahmen geliefert haben
  • Sie über exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Geschäftsleben verfügen, sowohl in formellen als auch in informellen Präsentationen und schriftlichen Arbeiten ueberzeugen
  • Sie energiegeladen sind und effektiv in einem dynamischen, wachsenden und sich ständig verändernden Umfeld agieren können

 

Anforderungen:

  • Relevanter Hochschulabschluss in Marketing, PR oder medizinischer Kommunikation
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

Working with Real HART: Since the pandemic, we have adapted to how our people told us they want to work. We have office locations in cities in the US, UK, and Europe with many employees and clients that serve as hubs where and when they need us. For employees who are within an hour of one of our offices, we expect attendance in the office two days per week, either at a Real Chemistry office or onsite with clients. We are also actively opening new office locations, so if one opens near you, our Real HART policy will apply. We are not looking for attendance for the sake of attendance but believe that the opportunity to coordinate in-office team meetings, 1:1 meetings with managers, taking advantage of on-site learning, and connecting with client partners is a critical to delivering on our purpose of making healthcare what it should be. Outside of these offices, we have regions, where people work remotely but come together quarterly for collaboration, culture and learning opportunities. We call this our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach. Real Chemistry believes we are best together – and our workplace strategy fosters connection and collaboration in person – but also supports flexibility for our people.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

*Notice: Real Chemistry and its affiliates' names are being misused by scammers through messaging services, fake websites, and apps. Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

remotely-welbehealth:greenhouse:85267460.title: Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant
remotely-welbehealth:greenhouse:85267460.description:
***UP TO $5K SIGN ON BONUS***

At WelbeHealth, each participant of our program is guided by our interdisciplinary team (IDT) – composed of clinical and non-clinical members who work cohesively to provide quality patient-centered care. Our values and participant focus lead the way no matter what.

The Certified Occupational Therapist Assistant (COTA) is a key member of the IDT, collaborating with other members of the Rehabilitation team to implement care plans and providing condition updates to the clinical team. Under the direction of an Occupational Therapist, the COTA provides restorative and rehabilitative occupational therapy services to participants at the center and in their homes to maximize independence, safety, and performance of ADLs.

This role is different because COTAs at WelbeHealth: 

  • Have lower patient volumes – no more seeing 3-4 patients an hour
  • Form long-term relationships with participants rather than short-term rehab stints
  • Collaborate with other therapists, providers, and disciplines
  • Have work/life balance - no after hours of documentation

scribblevc-aerovect:ashbyhq:9f5cd824-80b.title: SMS & QMS Lead
scribblevc-aerovect:ashbyhq:9f5cd824-80b.description:
WHO WE ARE

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com.

The Safety & Quality Management System (SMS & QMS) Lead ensures both that AeroVect’s effectively identifies, assesses, and mitigates the unique risks of operating our Autonomous Ground Support Equipment (AGSE) at major airports and that we hold ourselves to the highest quality standard while doing so. The candidate will work directly with the Director of Safety, Systems, and Product and VP of Engineering to develop and own SMS and QMS processes that support and empower safe deployments. As the SMS & QMS Lead, you will be responsible for clearly demonstrating (with evidence) to the relevant authorities that the system was designed, tested, and monitored to the highest possible standard of care, informed by relevant standards and best practices.




YOU WILL

Hazard Identification & Safety Risk Management

 - Hazard Analysis: Lead specialized risk assessments to identify where system components, actors, and environmental conditions may combine into hazardous scenarios

 - Systemic Risk Oversight: Manage the Safety Risk Register for the fleet, ensuring concerns are analyzed for risk potential and mitigation plans are implemented

 - Residual Risk: Own the process for identifying, documenting, and mitigating residual risk before deploying into live operations

Safety Assurance

 - Processes: Develop a formal, top-down, organization-wide approach to managing safety risk and assuring the effectiveness of safety risk controls, including systematic procedures, practices, and policies for the management of safety risk

 - Proactive Monitoring: Ensure a structured, repeatable, systematic approach to proactively identify hazards and manage safety risk, including developing and implementing appropriate mitigations

 - Safety Reviews: Manage the Safety Council to continuously evaluate safety performance and maintain documentation supporting the ongoing operation of the fleet

 - External Advocacy and Certification Readiness: Serve as a key point of contact for relevant regulators regarding the safety maturity of our AGSE

QMS Architecture & Compliance

 - The Digital Thread: Implement and manage Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools to ensure traceability of hardware components and software versions across the global fleet

 - Quality Assurance and Oversight: Partner with the Engineering to enable automated quality gates in the CI/CD pipeline and establish rigorous Incoming Quality Control (IQC) testing protocols for key HW suppliers (e.g., LiDAR, compute, etc.)

 - Root Cause Analysis: Lead the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) process when events occur in the field




YOU HAVE

 - BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace, or equivalent preferred

 - Extensive knowledge and hands-on experience with developing and managing safety-critical autonomous deployments, including a proven track record of successfully certifying complex systems or operating under a formal SMS in a regulated environment

 - 5+ years in Aviation Safety, Systems Safety, and / or Quality Engineering, with at least 3 years in a highly regulated high-tech environment (Aerospace or Autonomous Vehicles)

 - SMS Mastery including a comprehensive knowledge of relevant ICAO and FAA standards

 - Demonstrated ability to successfully manage XFN teams to align on a unified process vision and deliver against it

 - Ability to articulate technical issues and solutions to all levels of the business, within and beyond the engineering communities




WE PREFER

 - MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or other related technical disciplines

 - Experience with fostering a safety culture in the context of aviation / airline or robotics applications

 - Familiarity with airport / airline operations and / or the airside driving environment at major global airports

 - Experience with safety standards in the development and deployment of complex autonomous systems (including but not limited to ISO 26262, ISO 21448, UL 4600, IEC 61508, ANSI B56.5, ISO3691, ANSI 15.08)

 - Bonus points for professional certifications, including SMS-certified, CSP, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Lead Auditor
